text:
Here is my song for the asking
Ask me and I will play
So sweetly, I’ll make you smile
This is my tune for the taking
Take it, don’t turn away
I’ve been waiting all my life

这是我为你请求而唱的歌
只要你开口，我就弹给你听
轻轻地，我会让你微笑
这是我为你备好的曲子
拿去吧，别转身走开
我已经等了一辈子
author: Paul Simon
chapter: 演唱：Simon & Garfunkel｜专辑：Bridge over Troubled Water（发行：1970-01-26）｜首发：1970-01-26
